title: Witnessed drowning suicide and VA denial of his service
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Witnessed drowning suicide and VA denial of his service, about about 2015 at Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I got out of the Air Force and I witnessed a suicide. Um dude drowned, multiple witnesses. I have the police report.

plain: Dylan Borland, a former member of the US Air Force, says that around 2015, after he left the service, he saw a man drown himself in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, with several other people watching, and that he has the police report. He says the VA, the US agency that cares for military veterans, denied parts of his service, and he points to his enlisted performance review, a routine Air Force job evaluation, and his VA medical records as backing. He tells it as part of his case that his record and his experiences are real.
